pages.text: $(bold)Purpose:$() to carry an inactive OBSR-EX to the Throne and complete its activation.$(br2)OBSR-EX's parameters are hard-wired into its hardware and can be loaded only at the Throne.
$(bold)Prerequisites:$()$(br2)$(li)carry an inactive OBSR-EX;$(br)$(li)place an Observer Base near the Throne.$(br2)Both are required.

$(bold)Start:$() right-click the pedestal block at the centre of the Throne with the base, and the ritual begins.$(br2)$(bold)Course:$() the ritual runs for a period, generating hostile creatures in waves.$(br2)Do not leave.$(br2)Moving away from the Throne pauses the ritual; where field conditions do not permit a pause, it is judged a failure.
$(bold)Settlement:$() when the ritual completes, the inactive OBSR-EX in the base is replaced by an activated version.
$(bold)Appendix: Ritual Requirements$()$(br2)The ritual does not require you to defeat anything.$(br2)The executor must remain present to sustain the ritual.
